goal: Decide whether one text message is likely a scam, likely safe, or uncertain, and explain why in plain words an older adult can understand.

message.text: IRS FINAL NOTICE: you owe back taxes. Pay now or police will arrest you today.

explanation: This looks like a scam. The message asks for money, threatens you, and pushes you to act fast. These are warning signs. The IRS will never call to demand immediate payment or threaten arrest.
what_to_do: Do not reply, do not tap any link, and do not send money or codes. If you are worried, call IRS at 1-800-555-0103 (from our trusted list).
guide_tip: Tip from our guide (G20): Slow down. Talk to someone you trust before you do anything.
